hero.title: Food Delivery
hero.text: Discover hundreds of restaurants and cuisines in your area. From local favorites to international delights, Purple World brings the best food options directly to you with just a few clicks. Fast delivery, reliable service, and a seamless ordering experience await.
hero.description1: What would you like to eat today?
hero.description2: Your favorite flavors are just a click away.

fastDelivery.title: Fast Delivery
fastDelivery.description: Get your food delivered to your doorstep in minutes. Enjoy hot and fresh meals thanks to our dedicated courier network.

reliableService.title: Reliable Service
reliableService.description: Track every order and see real-time updates on your delivery status. We always keep our delivery promise.

easyToUse.title: Easy to Use
easyToUse.description: Order from your favorite restaurants with just a few clicks using our simple and user-friendly interface. No complicated processes, just delicious food.

restaurantSection.title: Add Your Restaurant to Purple World Food Delivery
restaurantSection.description1: Expand your restaurant's reach and boost your revenue by joining our growing network of food partners. With Purple World, you'll gain access to thousands of hungry customers looking for quality food delivered right to their doorstep.
restaurantSection.description2: Our platform makes it easy to manage orders, customize your menu, and track your performance in real-time. We handle the delivery logistics so you can focus on what you do best - creating delicious food that keeps customers coming back for more.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.intro: Purple World Food Delivery began with a simple idea: to create a better food delivery experience for everyone involved - customers, restaurants, and couriers.
ourStory.paragraph1: What started as a small operation in Ankara has now grown into a nationwide service connecting thousands of restaurants with hungry customers across Turkey.
ourStory.paragraph2: We've built our platform with a focus on technology that makes ordering food as simple and enjoyable as possible, while also ensuring restaurants can efficiently manage their deliveries and our couriers can maximize their earnings.
ourStory.paragraph3: Today, we're proud to be Turkey's fastest-growing food delivery platform, with plans to expand our services even further in the coming years.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliance
gdpr.introduction: At Purple World, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal data is handled in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This page outlines our approach to data protection and your rights under the GDPR.

dataWeCollect.title: Data We Collect
dataWeCollect.description: We collect and process the following categories of personal data:
dataWeCollect.accountInfoDesc: Name, email address, phone number, and user credentials
dataWeCollect.deliveryInfoDesc: Delivery addresses, delivery preferences, and location data
dataWeCollect.paymentInfoDesc: Payment method details (processed through secure payment processors)
dataWeCollect.usageDataDesc: Order history, restaurant preferences, reviews, and ratings

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.description: We process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:
legalBasis.contractPerformanceDesc: Processing necessary to fulfill our service contract with you
legalBasis.legitimateInterestsDesc: Improving our services, ensuring security, and business analytics
legalBasis.consentDesc: Marketing communications and optional features (where you have provided explicit consent)
legalBasis.legalObligationsDesc: Compliance with applicable laws and regulations

yourRights.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
yourRights.rightToAccessDesc: You have the right to request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. You can access this information by logging into your account or by contacting our Data Protection Officer. We will provide this information within 30 days of your request.
yourRights.rightToRectificationDesc: If you believe that any personal data we hold about you is inaccurate or incomplete, you can update your information directly through your account settings or contact us to correct this information.
yourRights.rightToErasureDesc: You have the right to request the deletion of your personal data under certain circumstances, such as when the data is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. You can delete your account through the profile settings or contact us to request erasure of your data.
yourRights.rightToDataPortabilityDesc: You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format, and to transmit this data to another controller without hindrance from us. You can request a copy of your data for portability purposes at any time.
yourRights.rightToObjectDesc: You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing purposes. If you wish to object to data processing, please contact our Data Protection Officer.
yourRights.rightToRestrictionDesc: You can request that we restrict the processing of your personal data under certain conditions, such as if you contest the accuracy of the data or if the processing is unlawful.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.description: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including legal, accounting, or reporting requirements. Different types of data may be retained for different periods:
dataRetention.accountInfoDesc: Retained while your account is active; deleted or anonymized within 30 days of account closure
dataRetention.orderHistoryDesc: Retained for 3 years for business analytics and customer service purposes
dataRetention.paymentInfoDesc: Retained only as long as necessary to process transactions and handle refunds

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.description: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized or unlawful processing, accidental loss, destruction, or damage. These measures include:
dataSecurity.encryptionDesc: All data transmission between your device and our servers is encrypted using SSL/TLS protocols
dataSecurity.accessControlsDesc: Strict access controls and authentication mechanisms for all personnel accessing user data
dataSecurity.securityAssessmentsDesc: Periodic security assessments and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities
dataSecurity.dataBreachProceduresDesc: Comprehensive data breach detection, reporting, and notification procedures

internationalTransfers.title: International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.description: HU-FDS primarily processes and stores data within the European Economic Area (EEA). However, when data is transferred outside the EEA, we ensure that appropriate safeguards are in place, such as Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission or other lawful transfer mechanisms.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.description: Our platform uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or through our cookie consent tool that appears when you first visit our site.

dpoContact.title: Data Protection Officer Contact
dpoContact.description: If you have any questions about our data protection practices or wish to exercise your GDPR rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer:

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.description: If you are not satisfied with our response to your concerns, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection supervisory authority in your country of residence.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.introduction: At Purple World, we use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, personalize content, and improve the quality of our services. This Cookie Policy explains how we use these technologies, what types of cookies we use, and how you can control your cookie preferences.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile phone) when you visit a website. They allow the website to recognize your device and remember some information about your visit, such as your preferences and settings. Cookies are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide valuable information to website owners.

typesOfCookies.title: Types of Cookies We Use
typesOfCookies.description: We use different types of cookies for various purposes:
typesOfCookies.essentialDesc: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be switched off in our systems
typesOfCookies.performanceDesc: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site
typesOfCookies.functionalDesc: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalization
typesOfCookies.targetingDesc: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners to build a profile of your interests

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.description: We use cookies for the following purposes:
howWeUse.authenticationDesc: To recognize you when you log in to use our services
howWeUse.preferencesDesc: To remember information about your preferences and settings
howWeUse.analyticsDesc: To understand how users interact with our website, which pages are visited most often, and identify any issues with our service
howWeUse.securityDesc: To detect and prevent fraudulent activity and ensure the security of your account

managingPreferences.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
managingPreferences.consentToolDesc: When you first visit our website, you will be presented with a cookie banner that allows you to accept or decline non-essential cookies. You can change your preferences at any time by clicking the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer of our website.
managingPreferences.browserSettingsDesc: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings preferences. You can typically find these settings in the "Options" or "Preferences" menu of your browser. To understand these settings, the following links may be helpful:
managingPreferences.disablingCookiesDesc: Please note that if you choose to disable cookies, you may not be able to access certain parts of our website or some features may not function properly. In particular, you will not be able to use features that require authentication, such as placing orders or accessing your account information.
managingPreferences.thirdPartyCookiesDesc: Some cookies are placed by third parties on our behalf. These third parties may include analytics providers, advertising networks, and social media platforms. We do not have control over these third-party cookies. You can manage your preferences for third-party cookies through your browser settings or using the opt-out mechanisms provided by these third parties.

doNotTrack.title: Do Not Track Signals
doNotTrack.description: Some browsers have a "Do Not Track" feature that signals to websites you visit that you do not want to have your online activity tracked. Due to the lack of a common industry or legal standard for interpreting these signals, our website does not currently respond to "Do Not Track" signals. However, you can use the cookie management options described above to control how your information is collected through cookies.

otherTechnologies.title: Other Tracking Technologies
otherTechnologies.description: In addition to cookies, we may use other similar technologies such as web beacons (pixel tags), device identifiers, and tracking URLs to identify you and track your usage patterns. These technologies work similarly to cookies by storing information locally on your device or by identifying your browser or device.

changes.title: Changes to Our Cookie Policy
changes.description: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will post the updated policy on our website and change the "Last Updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about our use of cookies.
